title: Ankhorage Neo4j Graph
summary: Provides a concrete Neo4j persistence adapter for the canonical Ankhorage Graph persistence port.
purpose: Implement portable, identity-stable graph persistence using Neo4j Query API v2 without leaking provider-specific Cypher into consumers.
responsibilities: Map the published Graph persistence port to Neo4j nodes, typed directed relationships, bounded traversals and explicit transactions.
Own Neo4j authentication, Query API v2 transport, schema preparation, provider-specific error reporting and redaction.
boundaries: Does not own generic Graph persistence contracts, graph algorithms or application business entities.
Does not use unapproved third-party drivers, persist secrets into application manifests, or implement a separate Cypher abstraction.
audience: Application and service developers requiring Neo4j-backed graph persistence.

architecture.role: Concrete outbound adapter and composition for a provider-neutral graph port.
invariants: Only released public @ankhorage/graph persistence APIs are imported.
Mutation operations commit atomically and preserve stable node and relationship identities.
Neo4j-specific transport details and authorization remain server-side.

limitations: Requires a released @ankhorage/graph persistence port and an explicitly prepared Neo4j schema.
Query API v2 explicit transactions require Aura or compatible single-instance/affinity routing.
Arbitrary nested portable graph properties are serialized as a lossless JSON field, not native indexed properties.
